of whom the world was not worthy—wandering in deserts, mountains, caves, and the holes of the earth.

translations.web: They are wet with the showers of the mountains, and embrace the rock for lack of a shelter.
translations.bsb: Drenched by mountain rains, they huddle against the rocks for want of shelter.
